text:
ajay: Heads up — seeing ~40% fewer spans than requests for GPU inference in ap-southeast. Grafana panel 'trace/span_count vs requests' dropped around 10:12 UTC. Link: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/fleet-traces

maria: saw similar, thanks. Quick look shows a lot of runtime spans with no parent_id. Requests still have request_id and logs present, so it's specifically trace propagation.

kevin: grepping runtime logs: `INFO incoming headers: {\"traceparent\": \"\", \"x-request-id\": \"req-923\"}` — there are many where traceparent is an empty string. That suggests header got stripped or mangled before the runtime SDK picks it up.

ajay: pasted a minimal repro curl to the edge (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H 'traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01' \
  https://edge.ap-southeast.redwood/api/v1/infer -d '{...}'
```
Edge reply shows `traceparent` present, but when traffic tunnels through gateway->ingress-proxy->runtime it's blank.

maria: We rolled a sampling and routing config on the gateway yesterday for cheaper tails; changed sampler from parentbased -> traceidratio. That shouldn't drop propagation, but we did also touch the HTTP/2 header translation config.

kevin: found envoy listener config snippet in the rolling change: `strip_tracing_headers: true` (WTF). That would explain it — config intended to remove `x-otlp-*` but rules were too broad.

ajay: confirmed in bootstrap: the change was meant to remove `x-otlp-*` but rules were too broad.

incbot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-102 - Traces not propagating through ap-southeast gateway (priority P2).

deploy-bot: rolling rollback of gateway config to commit `c8a3f2d` in staging -> 1/3 -> 2/3 -> done :thumbsup:

kevin: quick patch for runtime SDK pushed as defense-in-depth: if `traceparent` missing, try `x-cloud-trace-context` and fallback to generating new trace but log a metric `trace.propagation.failure=1`. Patch:
```
if not headers.get('traceparent'):
    fallback = headers.get('x-cloud-trace-context')
    if fallback:
        propagator.extract(fallback)
    else:
        metrics.counter('trace.propagation.failure').inc()
```

maria: thanks — can you also add a Grafana ratio panel: propagated_spans / total_infer_requests? I've created an alert: fires if ratio < 0.85 for 5m.

kevin: panel added at https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/tracing-prop. Alert rule created (ID: alert-7721).

ajay: after rollback + canary SDK patch, propagation ratio back to ~99% on canary nodes. Will roll to 100% in 30m.

maria: please include the exact config diff in the postmortem — the `strip_tracing_headers` change is the root cause. Also add runbook step: verify W3C `traceparent` is preserved through HTTP/2 upgrades.

ajay: will write a short postmortem and link to incident. Thanks everyone for quick turn. :heart:

incbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-2026-102 (resolved in 00:45).
